angleRead.text: The dossier on Vladimir Gonzalez is three seasons long, and the line that jumps is not the 2039 season — it is the gap between 2037 and 2038. In 2037, over 61 at-bats, he hit a home run every 30.5 at-bats and struck out every 7.6. In 2038, over 120 at-bats, the home run rate collapsed to one every 60.0 at-bats and the strikeout rate tightened to one every 4.8. That is a thin-sample swing, and the 2039 season — 506 at-bats, one home run every 36.1, one strikeout every 6.5 — sits between the two.
